resources.string: Runs while a conversation is active.

Start live mode, put the phone down and just talk. When you pause, your message is sent by itself, the answer is read out, and then the app listens again. Saying “stop” ends the conversation without touching anything.
This needs permission to use the microphone.
Speech output could not be started.
There is no API key yet. Sign in first.
Mistral rejected the API key. Sign in again with a valid key.
Mistral refused the request (no permission for this model or feature).
Mistral is limiting requests right now. Wait a moment and try again.
Mistral could not process the request.
Mistral could not process the request: %1$s
Mistral has a problem on its side. Try again in a moment.
No connection to Mistral. Check your internet connection.
Mistral sent an answer this app does not understand.
Talk to Mistral\'s models without touching the screen. The app needs an API key from your Mistral account.
This opens the Mistral console in your browser. Log in the way you always do - Google, Microsoft, Apple or e-mail. This app never sees your password.
No browser was found to open the page. Open console.mistral.ai on any device instead.
In the console open “API keys” in the menu, tap “Create new key” and copy it - it is shown only once. No account yet? Mistral has a free plan to try things out; it asks for a phone number.
Nothing to paste. Copy the key in the console first.
That does not look like an API key. Copy the key itself from the console.
Mistral did not accept this key. Check that you copied all of it.
The key could not be stored securely on this device.

Mistral offers no “Sign in with Google” for other apps - only API keys. The key is stored encrypted on this device and sent only to api.mistral.ai. Usage is billed to your Mistral account. This is an unofficial app and not affiliated with Mistral AI.
Signing out deletes the key from this device. The key stays valid in your Mistral console until you delete it there.
Type any model id - a fine-tuned one, say - or tap the arrow to choose from your account\'s list.
The model list has not been loaded. Check your connection and refresh, or type a model id below.
Listen again automatically after every answer
Clear the conversation whenever live mode starts
Used for listening, for the language of the answers and for the voice.
Follows what you say. Works best with Mistral Voxtral for listening; the phone\'s recognizer and the voice use the phone\'s language.
The language chosen above is added to this instruction automatically, so the text can stay in English.
Free and quick to start. The phone\'s recognizer decides when you are done, and may send the audio to Google.

The audio goes to Mistral (billed per minute, which is very little). The app waits for exactly the pause you set. No start-up beep. It listens for the language chosen under Conversation - or detects it, if you chose Automatic.
Voxtral does not list %1$s among the languages it transcribes. It will try to detect the language by itself and may get it wrong.
After this much quiet, your message is sent. Raise it if you get cut off while you are thinking.
Only a hint for the phone\'s recognizer, and many ignore it. Choose Mistral Voxtral for an exact pause.
Keeps the audio on the phone; needs the offline language pack
Free, starts instantly and works offline.
Natural, expressive voices, billed per character. Falls back to the phone\'s voice whenever Mistral cannot speak.
Picks a voice that speaks the language; the phone\'s voice if none does
No Mistral voice speaks %1$s. With Automatic, the phone\'s voice reads the answers; or pick a voice to hear %1$s with its accent.
%1$s does not list %2$s, so it will speak it with its own accent.
No voices were found for this account.

Handsfree for Mistral is an unofficial, open-source client. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mistral AI. Your conversation is sent to Mistral\'s API. Audio leaves the phone only if you choose a speech option above that says so.
No speech recognition is set up on this device. Mistral Voxtral works without it: choose it under Settings → Listening.
Speech recognition could not be started.
The app is not allowed to use the microphone.
No offline speech package is installed for %1$s. Download it in the system settings under voice input, or turn off “Prefer on-device recognition”.
The phone\'s recognizer does not support %1$s.
Speech recognition needs a connection and could not reach its server.
The microphone could not be read.
Another app is using the microphone.
No speech output is set up on this device.
The speech data for %1$s is missing. Install it in the system settings under text-to-speech.
No voice is installed for %1$s. Without one the phone stays silent.
Speech output was not ready, the sentence was lost.
Mistral\'s voice failed (%1$s). Using the phone\'s voice instead.
No Mistral voice is available for this account. Using the phone\'s voice.
No Mistral voice speaks %1$s, so the phone\'s voice reads the answers. To hear a Mistral voice anyway (it will have an accent), pick one under Settings → Voice.
